title: my_coworkers_timecard
display_title: I've been clocking in my coworker for three years and he doesn't know he's dead
beats: I still clock in for a guy who died three years ago, and payroll has never noticed.
Marcus (41M) trained me at the warehouse, then had a heart attack in the break room on a Tuesday.
The night before, he'd asked me to cover his shift Friday so he could see his kid's recital.
I never told him yes, and I never told anyone that either.
When HR asked me to 'process his final paperwork,' I found his login still active.
So I started clocking him in every morning, just fifteen minutes, then clocking him out.
His direct deposit still hits an account I'm guessing his ex-wife closed years ago.
Three years, forty absent hours a week, and nobody's flagged it once.
I don't even know why I keep doing it anymore, I just can't be the one who finally logs him off.
